title: MulmoTerminal — the editor follows the agent's edits as they land
description: Short feature clip. Enlarging a cell puts a folder toggle in its header: terminal on the left, editor on the right — and when the agent rewrites the open file, the buffer follows. Slides are English in both language versions.

beats.text: Open a file beside the terminal, and the editor follows the agent's edits as they land.
